content:
sam: Heads-up — planning to add actor-resolution hints to audit exports so downstream SIEMs can link events to our user catalog. want to align on formats and privacy before a rollout.

nora: +1. primary concern: PII leakage. We should support explicit redaction modes: full_actor_id, hashed_actor_id, pseudonymized_hint. Also add a small actor_hint field instead of dumping emails.

raj: We also need to keep the justification/why field when support or automation makes a change. Otherwise the audit trail loses context for compliance reviews.

kevin: Proposed API params: include_actor_hints: enum(full, hashed, pseudonym, none), sample_pct: number (0-100), redaction_mode: enum. Example NDJSON row:
```
{"ts":"2024-02-20T10:12:34Z","event":"policy.change","tenant":"org-72","actor_hint":"acct-12345","actor_id":"u-aaaa","change":{"policy":"routing-1","diff":"+target:edge-2"}}
```
This keeps a compact hint and optional canonical id.

compliance-bot: Reminder: EU customers may require pseudonymization by default. Make the per-tenant default configurable and enforced server-side. Also surface in export metadata which mode was used.

sara: About sampling — if we allow sample_pct, it must be deterministic (so sampled set doesn't change across replays). Use hash(actor_id||event_ts) % 100 < sample_pct. That way security investigations are reproducible.

ops-bot: Practical numbers: a mid-size org produces ~300k audit events/day. NDJSON gzipped is ~30–50MB/day. Exports can spike; we need backpressure, queued export workers, and a pagination token for consumers. Also enforce export quotas per tenant to avoid noisy neighbors.

nora: Rollout suggestion: UI toggle in Console -> Audit -> Exports: "Actor hints" with three radio options + sample slider. Add a small tooltip: "Pseudonymized for EU tenants by default". Canary to 5% of orgs first, then 25%.

kevin: Telemetry we should emit: export_bytes, export_events_count, export_sample_pct, export_redaction_mode, export_latency_ms, export_rate_limited=true/false. Benchmarks: measure impact on CPU when resolving actor ids (we may need a cache).

sam: Action items: 1) API spec draft (raj) 2) Console UX mock + tooltip (nora) 3) telemetry + backpressure design (kevin/ops) 4) compliance review for EU defaults (compliance-bot). I'll open an RFC/PR and link it here.

sam: RFC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/432 

raj: I'll start the spec today and add example payloads + edgecases (bot actors, service principals, deleted accounts).

sara: Also add tests verifying deterministic sampling and ability to regen a full trail if tenant requests full export (subject to retention/PII policy).

nora: I'll mock the console path and add text for the tooltip. Keeping wording simple helps legal + support. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Noted — will add quota enforcement ticket and perf test for export worker pipeline.

sam: Thanks everyone. We'll sync in tomorrow's eng-platform standup if needed.
